title: CompTIA Security+
overview: The global foundational cybersecurity baseline validating core technical knowledge across risk management, threat mitigation, security controls, and enterprise operations.
versionNotice: Current Exam: SY0-701 (Released November 7, 2023; English version retirement: June 11, 2027. Successor SY0-801 expected launch: ~November 17, 2026). Ensure your study materials specifically target SY0-701 objectives.

examFormat.questionTypes: Multiple choice and performance-based simulation questions (PBQs)

preparationTips: Review the official CompTIA SY0-701 exam objectives PDF line by line as a study checklist
Practice hands-on simulation questions (configuring firewall rules and ACLs) before exam day
Complete Professor Messer's free video playlist and practice exams for targeted domain mastery

title: CompTIA Network+
overview: Validates foundational technical knowledge required to establish, maintain, secure, and troubleshoot essential wired and wireless networks.
versionNotice: Current Exam: N10-009 (Launched June 2024). Replaced N10-008 which retired in December 2024.

examFormat.questionTypes: Multiple choice and performance-based simulation questions

preparationTips: Master CIDR subnet calculations until you can determine host ranges mentally within 30 seconds
Memorize standard port numbers and their corresponding RFC protocols
Use packet capturing tools (Wireshark) to inspect genuine TCP handshakes and DNS queries

title: Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA)
overview: Rigorous networking certification covering dual-stack IP addressing, Cisco IOS command line, routing protocols (OSPF), VLANs, STP, enterprise wireless, and network automation.
versionNotice: Current Exam: 200-301 v1.1 (Updated August 2024 to include Generative AI networking concepts, cloud management, and API programmability).

examFormat.questionTypes: Multiple choice, drag-and-drop, and interactive lab configurations (Packet Tracer style)

preparationTips: Build every topology in Cisco Packet Tracer or GNS3 alongside Jeremy's IT Lab video series
Use spaced repetition flashcards (Anki) daily for CLI syntax, command output, and subnetting
Practice diagnosing misconfigured subnet masks, overlapping ACLs, and mismatched VLAN tags

title: CompTIA Cybersecurity Analyst (CySA+)
overview: Applies behavioral analytics to networks and devices to prevent, detect and combat cybersecurity threats through continuous security monitoring.
versionNotice: Current Exam: CS0-003 (Active since 2023). Focuses heavily on threat intelligence, SIEM tools, and cloud environments.
preparationTips: Gain hands-on experience parsing SIEM alerts on platforms like LetsDefend or TryHackMe SOC rooms
Practice interpreting CVSS v3/v4 metrics and prioritizing CVE remediation
Analyze genuine firewall, IDS/IPS, and system event logs

title: OffSec Certified Professional (OSCP)
overview: The gold standard in hands-on ethical hacking. Candidates must independently compromise vulnerable machines in an isolated proctored 24-hour examination network and submit a formal report.
versionNotice: PEN-200 incorporates updated Active Directory exploitation vectors, pivoting techniques, and modernized Linux/Windows privilege escalation methods.

examFormat.duration: 23 Hours 45 Minutes (Plus 24 hours for report submission)
examFormat.maxQuestions: Hands-on target hosts + Active Directory domain set
examFormat.questionTypes: Practical penetration testing lab and formal report writing

preparationTips: Complete the entire Path C on CyberTube before enrolling in PEN-200
Complete at least 30-40 retired Hack The Box and Proving Grounds machines independently
Develop meticulous note-taking habits using Obsidian or CherryTree with timestamped screenshots

title: AWS Certified Security - Specialty
overview: Validates technical mastery of securing AWS workloads, multi-account governance with AWS Organizations, KMS encryption, threat detection with GuardDuty, and incident response.
versionNotice: Current Exam: SCS-C02 (Active). Validates modern multi-account security architectures and zero-trust IAM policies.
preparationTips: Deeply understand AWS KMS key policies, envelope encryption, and cross-account bucket policies
Build practical security pipelines using AWS Config rules, GuardDuty, and Security Hub
Audit cloud configurations using free open-source tools like Prowler and ScoutSuite
